# Krenko Goblins
## Goal
Goblin tribal that goes wide fast: one build for a casual table and one for a stronger pod.
## Commander
Krenko, Mob Boss
## Table and power
Bracket 3 (main), bracket 4 variant. Hard lines: no extra turns, no mass land denial.
## Budget
About $250 for the bracket 3 build.
## Theme
- Mode: prefer (on theme unless an exception is approved)
- Counts as on theme: Goblin creatures and cards that make Goblins; utility cards exempt
- Artwork matters: no
- Allowed exceptions: Coat of Arms
## Must include / never include
## Platform
Moxfield
